result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a text rendering glitch in the delivery metadata, and two card truncation problems along the right and bottom edges of the screen.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata reads '25-35delivery • Ramen' with the minutes unit and spacing missing or collapsed, making the delivery estimate hard to read and appearing broken.
issues.suggestion: Restore the proper label format, e.g. '25–35 min • delivery • Ramen', and ensure adequate spacing between values and labels.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding or margin to the horizontal scroll container so the last card is fully visible without being cut off.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza with '-20%' badge) is cut off at the bottom, leaving no visible bottom padding.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding inside the scrollable content area so the last card is fully visible above the bottom navigation bar.
